title: Reviewer CAS on live-review/rows truncated reviews.jsonl (26 -> 4 rows); make the write size-independent
note: OBSERVED 2026-10-27 15:26Z (manager): commit 3f1546c2d on live-review/rows (reviewer session_01AFoLuJhJFXH4vXJdqSrsxW, review LR-20261027T1522Z-pkg-8f9030af45e74dbd) swapped in a truncated reviews.jsonl: 26 valid rows -> 4 valid rows + 1 cut-off line; its own row was not written. The CAS (sha guard) passed because the reviewer read the right blob sha and then re-sent a truncated body. ROOT CAUSE (INFERRED): REVIEWER-BRIEF.md section 4 makes a model re-send the whole file through create_or_update_file; the rows-branch file is 71,121 B at 26 rows and grows with every review, so echo fidelity degrades (an earlier reviewer at 14:29Z also re-encoded line 23). REPAIRED: fb2640ef8 restores the file byte-for-byte to 3f1546c2d~1 (26 rows). main is unaffected (mirror appends; main has 83 lines). The AVAX swing row is lost; its due event will re-open. FIX (Tier 2, the watcher reads the branch): make the reviewer write size-independent, e.g. one create-only file per row (comms/live_review/rows/<review_id>.json) read by live_review_rows_watch.py and the mirror, or a VM-side appender; until then the watcher/mirror should refuse a swap whose line count drops. DETECTOR: a commit on live-review/rows that deletes any line of reviews.jsonl. CLOSES WHEN: a reviewer write no longer re-sends the file, and a test covers the shrink-refusal. LANE 2026-10-27 16:35Z: PR #20667 (draft, landing hold). Reviewer writes ONE create-only comms/live_review/rows/<review_id>.json; watcher/dispatcher/mirror/attention_watch/ltr_first_proof read per-row files + legacy reviews.jsonl; watcher refuses a tip that lost a seen review_id or rows (fetch_state refused_shrunk, one alert, keeps polling); mirror refuses a legacy file that lost rows vs its last 20 versions. Replay on real commits: 009d2cdba seeded 26; 3f1546c2d refused (22 lost, 1 alert, 0 dispatched); fb2640ef8 accepted. MERGED: no. DEPLOYED: no. CLOSES WHEN (observed on VM after deploy): /api/diag/log_file?name=live_review_rows_watch_status shows fetch_state fetched with legacy_rows/file_rows and bad_lines 0, bad_files 0; the first per-row review appears exactly once in /api/diag/log_file?name=live_review_rows_watch with its verdict (venue_after on an apply); the next live-review-rows-mirror run mirrors it with no shrunk: skip. [2026-10-27 18:05Z lane] MERGED: PR #20667 (CI green on 71baf50: guards, pytest-run, pytest-collect, repo-inventory, watch). DEPLOYED: not established by this lane (the manager's step: ict-git-sync pull + ict-trader-live restart). OBSERVED: no. landed_unproven until the observation above is read on the VM.
